method: Compare building TEXCOORD_2/TEXCOORD_3 UV masks against each exported CommercialArea lightmap; rank by gradient-detail ratio inside/outside the mask and vertical-flip convention.
notes: HQ_Lightmap0_138 was the highest HQ candidate under the likely UE lightmap V-flip convention.
A PBRMaterial.lightmapTexture trial with TEXCOORD_2/vScale=-1/vOffset=1 did not produce a verifiable visual change in the same-camera capture, so it was reverted and is not applied.
True binding still requires the component LightMapIndex or FLightMap2D texture reference.

uv2AlignmentTrial.result: The lightmap bands aligned with the facade/frame/base geometry, confirming the UV candidate, but the exported PNG contains chart-coloured/debug-looking values (purple/green/pink), not neutral lighting. The UModel PNG cannot be used as the final lightmap until the Lightmass/HDR format is decoded correctly.
